A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the restoration of chial symmetry is a consequence of the restoration of the confinement and not the other way around.
the chiral symmetry is restored in a way that depends strongly on the Polyakov loop sector and that the chiral phase transition is not a phase transition in the sense of statistical physics.
the chiral symmetry restoration is driven by the deconfinement transition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the restoration of chirlal symmetry at high temperature is a consequence of the loss of confinement and not vice versa as is usually assumed.
